params.name: aTable
params.description: Table whose table-form object methods to return; if omitted, returns objects of the database project forms instead.

params.name: arrPaths
params.description: Array of method paths and names

params.name: filter
params.description: Name filter; supports '@' for "starts with"/"ends with"/"contains"; an empty string is ignored.

params.name: stamp
params.description: In: minimum modification-counter stamp value to filter on. Out: the new current (highest) stamp value, for use in a subsequent call to get only newer/modified methods.
If passed, applies to the host database's methods when called from a component (otherwise ignored).

constraints: The command does not list objects of inherited forms or of subforms.
If the command detects a duplicated method name, error -9802 ("Object path not unique") is generated.
